what: HIGH (code audit CA-A09, AUD-20260927-A09-autoland-pr-author-pat): the ARMED auto-land route for MD-DEMOTE-S2-S1 cannot land. .github/workflows/r4-demotion-gate.yml opens the demotion PR with `gh pr create` under GH_TOKEN=secrets.BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN, a fine-grained PAT owned by `benbaichmankass` (docs/github-actions-workflows.md:441,1199). MEASURED: PR #13158, opened by the identical mechanism (commit-to-main action, gh pr create with that PAT), has user.login=benbaichmankass. pr-landing-guard R16 -> check_mandate_autoland.check_author (scripts/ci/check_mandate_autoland.py:600-610) requires pull_request.user.login == 'github-actions[bot]' and fails otherwise; `guards` is a required check with enforce_admins. So on the first FIRE the pre-flight says ADMISSIBLE (it skips the author read), the PR body and the send-ping say 'lands itself on green', auto-merge is enabled, and then guards goes RED and the de-risk cut never merges -- the net-negative real-money leg keeps trading until someone rewrites the declaration to hold and merges by hand. No test can catch it: every self-test fixture plants login='github-actions[bot]'. FIX (Tier-2, landing machinery): either (a) accept the PAT owner in A7 only together with a second token-provenance fact the PR carries (e.g. head commit authored+committed by the bot AND the branch pushed by the r4-demotion-gate run, cross-checked via the Actions API run's head_branch), or (b) open the PR with GITHUB_TOKEN (bot author) and solve the no-CI-on-bot-PR problem separately (PI-20260927 CI-auth item). Add a test that parses r4-demotion-gate.yml and asserts the token used for `gh pr create` produces the login A7 requires.
